description: Find the first value equal to a target in a list. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, missing or null value input matches null entries, and no match returns -1.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to inspect. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value to find by equality. Missing or null input matches null entries.

outputs.name: index
outputs.description: Returns the first zero-based index of a value equal to the target, or -1 when no match exists.

description: Count values equal to a target in a list. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, missing or null value input matches null entries, and equality is checked for every item.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to inspect. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value to count by equality. Missing or null input matches null entries.

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: Returns the number of list values equal to the target, including null matches when the target is null.

description: Read the first value in a list. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, and an empty list returns null.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List whose first value should be read. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

outputs.name: item
outputs.description: Returns the first value, or null when the list is missing, null, or empty.

description: Read the last value in a list. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, and an empty list returns null.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List whose last value should be read. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

outputs.name: item
outputs.description: Returns the last value, or null when the list is missing, null, or empty.

description: Return the first value that matches a property predicate. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, the property may be blank to inspect each value, and no match returns null.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to inspect. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: property_name
inputs.description: Property to inspect. Missing or blank input compares each list value directly.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Predicate used to compare each value.

inputs.name: compare_value
inputs.description: Value used by operators that compare against a target. Missing or null input uses null.

outputs.name: found_element
outputs.description: Returns the first matching value, or null when no value matches.

description: Find every index containing a target value. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, missing or null target matches null values, and indices remain in ascending order.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to inspect. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Value to find. Missing or null input matches null values.

outputs.name: indices
outputs.description: Returns every zero-based matching index in ascending order.

description: Find the first index whose value matches a condition. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, a blank condition selects the first non-null value, and no match returns -1.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to inspect. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: condition
inputs.description: Condition such as type:string, not_null, instanceof Type, a text fragment, or a numeric greater-than or less-than expression. Blank selects the first non-null value.

outputs.name: index
outputs.description: Returns the first matching zero-based index, or -1 when no value matches.

description: Check whether a list contains at least one value from another list. Missing or null inputs use empty lists, equality includes null values, and an empty item list returns true.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to inspect. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Values to search for. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

outputs.name: contains
outputs.description: Returns true when at least one item occurs in the list.

description: Check whether a list contains every value from another list. Missing or null inputs use empty lists, equality includes null values, and an empty item list returns true.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to inspect. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Values that must all be present. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

outputs.name: contains
outputs.description: Returns true when every item occurs in the list.

description: Return whether at least one value matches a property predicate. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, and a blank property compares each value directly.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to inspect. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: property_name
inputs.description: Property to inspect. Missing or blank input compares each list value directly.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Predicate used to compare each value.

inputs.name: compare_value
inputs.description: Value used by operators that compare against a target. Missing or null input uses null.

outputs.name: matches
outputs.description: Returns true when at least one value matches the predicate.

description: Return whether every value matches a property predicate. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, and a blank property compares each value directly.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to inspect. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: property_name
inputs.description: Property to inspect. Missing or blank input compares each list value directly.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Predicate used to compare each value.

inputs.name: compare_value
inputs.description: Value used by operators that compare against a target. Missing or null input uses null.

outputs.name: matches
outputs.description: Returns true when every value matches the predicate.

description: Return whether no values match a property predicate. Missing or null list input uses an empty list, and a blank property compares each value directly.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: List to inspect. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: property_name
inputs.description: Property to inspect. Missing or blank input compares each list value directly.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Predicate used to compare each value.

inputs.name: compare_value
inputs.description: Value used by operators that compare against a target. Missing or null input uses null.

outputs.name: matches
outputs.description: Returns true when no value matches the predicate.
